title: The Window Opened to the Good Smell
youtube_title: The Window Opened to the Good Smell | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Violeta notices that Papa has already taken care of a window opened because bread was somewhere in the lane. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Violeta does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
